title: Review of c03 fch-protocell c1 (SIBW): containment replicates on 2 fresh seeds with its chi=0 control, but 1 of 3 fresh seeds blows up at frame 1 and dt/2 turns seed 7 into a lumenless onion; Weak
summary: I looked at the claim's sheets, tracks and contrast.txt, then re-ran world.py with labkit on new seeds 7, 8 and 9, world_chi0.py on seed 7, and a dt/2 copy (dt 0.01, 800 steps per frame, same physical time; rerun_dt_half/world_dt_half.py) on seed 7, and measured lumen/outside contrast with the author's contrast.py (contrast_rerun.txt). Seed 7: from white noise, 4 closed vesicles with solute-filled lumens persist to t=800, contrast 23.6 at the end and >= 2 in every frame; chi=0 on the same seed falls to 1.16 (>= 2 in 13% of frames). Seed 9: 2 lumen vesicles and 2 multilamellar onions, contrast 15 -> 12 while outside solute builds up, >= 2 in every frame. Seed 8 failed: non-finite fields at frame 1. At dt/2, seed 7 nucleates a single large multilamellar onion with no lumen (contrast undefined, solute spread outside), unlike the 4 lumen vesicles at dt=0.02.

observations.S: rerun/seed7/sheet.png t=0: white noise over the whole domain; rings by t=32
observations.I: rerun/seed7/sheet.png t=32-800: 4 discrete vesicles persisting the whole run (6 persistent tracks)
observations.B: rerun/seed7/radial.png: amphiphile rim/core 2.27, rim/outside 29; the lumen is chemically distinct only with the barrier (rerun_chi0/seed7)
observations.W: contrast_rerun.txt: seed 7 lumen/outside 23.6 at t=800 (>=2 in 100% of frames) vs chi=0 1.16 (13%); seed 9 12.0 (100%)

seeds_run.result: fail: non-finite fields at frame 1 (numerical blow-up)
dt/2: one lumenless multilamellar onion; W not testable

controls_run.W: rerun_chi0/seed7 (chi=0, same seed): contrast 1.16 at t=800

verdicts.limitation: The explicit scheme is fragile: 1 of 3 fresh seeds blows up at the first frame, and halving dt changes which structures nucleate from the same noise (one onion instead of 4 lumen vesicles), so the outcome at the claimed dt is not dt-converged even if the containment mechanism is (the author's 1.5x grid run holds 16-36x). Onions without lumens are common (2 of 4 bodies on seed 9). Containment is of a passive solute that the membrane does not feel. I did not test damage or longer runs.
